newsitem.title: USA: Carnegie Hill reacquires Pitcairn Carnegie.
newsitem.headline: Carnegie Hill reacquires Pitcairn Carnegie.

text.p: Carnegie Hill Financial Inc said Tuesday it has reacquired from Pitcairn Trust Co and related entities the securities broker-dealer Pitcairn Carnegie Securities LP, together with certain investment advisory agreements.
The company had sold the broker-dealer and contracts to Pitcairn last year.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed. Both companies are privately held.

"We are confident that our decision to reacquire the broker-dealer and advisory contracts which we sold to Pitcairn last year will result in enhanced service to our clients and the opportunity to significantly expand our business," said Dale Krieger, president and chief executive of Carnegie Hill.
"We are delighted to have Pitcairn remain a significant investor in the company and look forward to continued collaboration when providing equity management and trust services to our clients."
